prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A young child stands confidently in the middle of a sunlit urban street, holding a bright orange basketball close to their chest with one arm while raising the other arm high in an expressive, triumphant gesture. The child wears a white sleeveless shirt, dark pants, and white sneakers, their curly hair softly illuminated by the warm, late afternoon sunlight. The background features a row of parked cars and blurred residential buildings, rendered with a shallow depth of field that draws focus to the child as the central subject. A dramatic lens flare and soft haze partially obscure the right side of the image, adding a cinematic, almost dreamlike quality. The color palette is dominated by warm golden tones and deep shadows, evoking a nostalgic, hopeful mood. The composition is dynamic, with the child slightly off-center, and the low camera angle enhances their sense of presence and youthful energy. The overall style is reminiscent of a coming-of-age film, blending realism with a touch of poetic atmosphere.
